verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਹੈ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur dhareeaau amaau hai lakh dhareeaau samaau kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Guru is such an immeasurable ocean that millions of rivers are absorbed in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਇਕਸ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਵਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: eikas ikas dhareeaau vich lakh teerath dhareeaau vaha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Millions of pilgrimage centres are there on each river and in each stream millions of waves are raised by nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਵਾਹੜੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਲਖ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: eikat ikat vaahaRai kudharat lakh tara(n)g uTha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: In that Guru-ocean myriad jewels and all the four ideals (dharma, arth, kam and moks) moves around in the form of fish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਣੁ ਰਤਨਾਵਲੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੀਨ ਤਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sair san ratanaavalee chaar padhaarath meen tara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: All these things are not equal even to one wave (one sentence) of the Guru-ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤ ਲਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: eikat lahar na pujanee kudharat a(n)t na a(n)t laha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The mystery of the extent of His power is unknowable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: piram piaale ik boo(n)dh gurmukh viralaa ajar jara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The unbearable drop of the cup of love can be cherished by any rare gurmukh.
The Guru himself sees that imperceptible Lord, who is not visible to others.
